description.value: Failure the target takes a −1 status penalty to attack rolls and skill checks for its next 3 actions, as the weight of what it's doing settles onto it all at once. Critical Failure the penalty is −2 instead. Success no effect. Read As — Unanswered: the creeping arrival of a guilty conscience. Choir of Ash: the dawning understanding that they picked the wrong thing to stand against.

cinderfall.incomplete: STRUCT-EFFECT-COMPANION: no companion effect file exists for this 3-actions penalty shape, unlike hold-the-line-effect.json's pattern. Proposed shape if built: FlatModifier selector:[attack, skill-check] type:status value:-1 (a -2 critical-failure value would need a second, mutually-exclusive companion or a ChoiceSet-recorded degree flag), but nothing tracks 'penalty lasts for the target's next 3 actions' -- that counter has no rule-element precedent either. Two stacked gaps, not one.
